sentence: Revenue reacts only past an adoption-intensity threshold and grows where complementary technologies and internal R&D stand behind the investment
passage: [Lee et al. (2022), p. 1] "We find that firm revenue increases only after sufficient investment in AI, and the benefits of AI adoption are greater at firms that also invest in complementary technologies and pursue internal R&D strategy."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately captures the passage's empirical findings regarding the required investment threshold and the amplifying effects of complementary technologies and internal R&D.
